# CIFRA

> CIFRA is a digital art streaming platform featuring 2700+ contemporary artworks, video art, and cinema from emerging artists across the Middle East, Asia, and Latin America.

CIFRA serves as both a direct-to-consumer streaming platform for media art and a B2B solution for corporate and institutional art experiences. The platform combines artist curation, community engagement, and exclusive membership benefits to support contemporary digital creators worldwide.

## Key Topics

- [Our Mission](https://cifra.com/article/our-mission): CIFRA's mission: supporting emerging artists across Middle East, Asia & Latin America
- [Getting Started](https://cifra.com/article/getting-started): Onboarding guide covering platform features, playlists & community participation

## Curated Collections & Recommendations

- [Media Art You Might Like](https://cifra.com/recommendations/press-play-cifra-starter-pack): CIFRA starter pack with curated recommendations from renowned media artists
- [Trending Now on CIFRA](https://cifra.com/recommendations/trending-now-on-cifra): Trending video art collection curated by Boris Eldagsen, Nour Ouayda & others
- [Reimagined Classics](https://cifra.com/recommendations/reimagined-classics): Media art collection reshaping classic stories by Khaled Hafez, Blas Payri
- [Media Artists on CIFRA](https://cifra.com/recommendations/meet-the-artists): Artist directory featuring Chen Zhou, Angelika Markul & contemporary digital artists

- [Join CIFRA Club – Our Art Lovers Community!](https://cifra.com/cifra-club): CIFRA Club membership: exclusive content, artist support & community subscription

- [CIFRA for Your Business](https://b2b.cifra.com): B2B platform: Art Stations, Insight Labs & HUBs for corporate digital art solutions
